title: SPDB v1.0.1 — Spanish Political Discourse Annotation Resource
description: SPDB is a reproducible annotation resource for pragmatic-function coding in Spanish parliamentary discourse. Version 1.0.1 is a provenance/metadata patch over v1.0.0: Wave-1 dual-coder labels and agreement metrics are unchanged (N=100; observed agreement 0.350; Cohen kappa ~0.235; Krippendorff alpha ~0.223; Fleiss kappa ~0.219; 65 disagreements). Exploratory post-hoc disagreement-cause classifications are AI-assisted and not independently human-verified. Revised codebook-v1.1.0 remains unvalidated. Not an adjudicated gold benchmark.
